svg.desc: Environment, sensor, and vehicle plugins enter through SDK boundaries. The deterministic core executes through backend adapters; metrics and experiment-schema produce benchmark evidence and reproducible artifacts.
svg.text: Plugin boundaries around a deterministic execution and measurement path

Environment, sensor, and vehicle plugins enter through SDK boundaries. The deterministic core executes through backend adapters; metrics and experiment-schema produce benchmark evidence and reproducible artifacts.
Package paths reflect the repository structure; release state is read from the committed platform artifact.
